2. Upload file of type '...'
3. Select setting '...'
4. See error

**Expected Behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Device & Environment:**

- OS: [e.g. iOS 17, macOS Sonoma, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04]

**File Sample Details (if applicable)**
